items.title: Pony AI (PONY) Plans 2,000 Robotaxis Across Europe And The Middle East
items.summary: Pony AI (NasdaqGS:PONY) agreed to expand its partnership with Uber to deploy over 2,000 robotaxis across Europe and the Middle East. The rollout will start in several European cities, with plans to extend to additional locations in the Middle East over time. The agreement is framed as a commercial-scale deployment that uses Pony AI technology within Uber's ride hailing platform.
